title: Amount of a PracticePay Patient Financing Returned-Payment Fee
content:
**Which return.** The returned payment the fee is for is the latest returned-payment entry on the plan by return date; where two returned-payment entries share the latest return date, the one recorded first is taken. When that latest returned payment came back for R07, R10, R29 or as a chargeback, or the plan has no returned-payment entry, the fee is 0.00.

**The fee.** The returned-payment fee for the plan's latest returned payment is the plan's standard returned-payment fee (the per-plan returned-payment fee of the PracticePay Patient Financing fee schedule), never more than the amount of the payment that came back, rounded half up to the nearest cent.

**How the figure is assembled.** The fee level takes the place of the standard fee, every share multiplies it, all shares applying together, the one-penalty limit then applies to that product, the result is never more than the amount of the payment that came back, and it is rounded half up to the nearest cent once, at the end.

A returned-payment fee that works out to 0.00 is not owed, and nothing is booked for it.

## Worked figures (hypothetical plan whose standard returned-payment fee is taken as 20.00 USD)

| Latest return | Amount that came back | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| code R01 | 150.00 | 20.00 |
| code R16 | 12.50 | 12.50 (held to the amount that came back) |
| code R10 | 150.00 | 0.00, not owed |
| debit card chargeback | 150.00 | 0.00, not owed |
| two returns on the same latest date, the first recorded with R07 and the second with R01 | 150.00 | the first recorded is taken: R07, 0.00 |
